title: primula auriculata subsp. tournefortii
intro: Primula auriculata subsp. tournefortii, commonly known as Auricula, is a plant species in the family Primulaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Primula auriculata subsp. tournefortii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
